# worlds. — a design sketchbook

A personal design sketchbook with distinct worlds, curated explorations, and a workshop of interactive studies.
Each experience has its own typeface, palette, and motion.
The hub marks studies that are still in progress.

## Pages

- [Hub](https://design.renocrypt.com/): the entrance. Warm cream paper, expanding colored navigation, original animated SVG illustrations, and an architectural Three.js lounge with daylight and evening lighting.
- [00 — Lab](https://design.renocrypt.com/lab/): the WebGL studies the build grew out of, monitored as channels on one phosphor console (near-black #0c0c0e, phosphor mint #62e6c8).
- [01 — Noir](https://design.renocrypt.com/worlds/01-noir/): a night-drive study in progress. Charcoal and bone, light as the only color, rendered in WebGL.
- [02 — Chrome](https://design.renocrypt.com/worlds/02-chrome/): liquid editorial. Warm-stone serif with a live-rendered liquid-chrome masthead; vermilion, pistachio and jade accents.
- [03 — Monument](https://design.renocrypt.com/worlds/03-monument/): a white void. One colossal condensed face sliced by hairlines, 32 seeded exhibits, wry museum labeling.
- [04 — Pulse](https://design.renocrypt.com/worlds/04-pulse/): a guided journey. One red, weight does the talking; one click's life told in five stations.
- [Type specimen](https://design.renocrypt.com/type/): hub type casting — Clash Display, Cabinet Grotesk and General Sans compared as display candidates.
- [Curated explorations](https://design.renocrypt.com/curated/): a collection of original immersive experiences, with readable introductions, context, and links to the work.

## Curated explorations

- [Bikini Atoll](https://design.renocrypt.com/curated/bikini-atoll/): an original 3D journey through a Marshall Islands lagoon, with WebGPU water, palm-lined islands, and underwater visits to USS Saratoga, IJN Nagato, and USS Arkansas. Free movement, ambient ocean sound, and changing light support the exploration. Field notes acknowledge the displacement of the Bikinian people and nuclear testing. Geography and ship models are artistic reconstructions, not a navigation or dive-planning chart.

## Lab studies

- [S1 — Living Matrix](https://design.renocrypt.com/lab/s1-living-matrix.html): WebGL attention lattice, orbit camera, dark.
- [S2 — Platonic Drift](https://design.renocrypt.com/lab/s2-platonic-drift.html): scroll camera path, five solids, light WebGL.
- [S4 — The Agent](https://design.renocrypt.com/lab/s4-the-agent.html): rigged robot, four animation states, orbit camera.
- [S5 — Cipher Engine](https://design.renocrypt.com/lab/s5-cipher-engine.html): a hand-built Enigma model you can type into, exploded rotors.

## Notes

- The site publishes static HTML/CSS/JS through GitHub Pages. Vite builds the shared site; curated experiences can retain their own standalone HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. There is no backend or application API.
- Site fonts are self-hosted; standalone experiences may use CDN fonts and libraries. Icons are drawn SVG, and the 3D scenes are generated in code.
- Random-looking details are seeded and stable between visits.
